notes.title: Imagined Leviathans Dev Update: More New Locations!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We hope you’re all as excited about Imagined Leviathans as we are! As we keep working on development we thought we’d show off a little more of the new game areas...

Steph’s Reckless Behaviour
This is one of the new areas / narrative branches we have been working on. Here is an abandoned road filled with deserted cars. There’s a firepit in a semi-sheltered spot next to the vehicles, and a large number of alcohol bottles. It’s clear the cars have been dented, smashed, destroyed by whoever visits here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38709509/c1bbd57db953e89c369d5f4c04f7c562ef6bd4fb.gif


You arrive at Steph’s home: a half-constructed hospital building, with a damaged crane precariously swinging a mass of steel directly above it in the wind. Inside you find a hungover woman with a fractured arm sitting by a fire. She’s been living here for some time. The interior is a mess of exposed wiring, unsafe floors, and abandoned construction tools.

Here, you will get to learn more about this character’s background and figure out if there is a way to convince her to join you on your mission.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38709509/342310206ef48092e850d3abc574652280977ce1.gif


Wishlist Imagined Leviathans
Make sure to give the Prologue a go and Wishlist Imagined Leviathans to be notified when it's out.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1528030/Imagined_Leviathans/

Happy surviving!
Far Few Giants Team

notes.title: Prologue update with bug fixes and huge performance boost!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Bug Fixes

Just a quick update to let you all know that we have just fixed the bugs people had been encountering in the prologue and also gave it a massive performance boost! 

We really appreciate all the feedback you have been giving us so far. Please do let us know what you think of the new update to the prologue, and any other bugs if you find them.

New Art Assets and Locations in Imagined Leviathans

Here’s a look at a couple of the new art assets from the main game that we’re working on:

Happy surviving!

notes.title: Major new update to The Imagined Leviathan: Prologue!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

As you may already know, we have recently rebranded ‘The Imagined Leviathan’ to be an official Prologue for our upcoming release, ‘Imagined Leviathans’. 

Updates!

We have just released a major new patch for The Imagined Leviathan: Prologue, which now acts as the first 20-30 minutes of play for the main game. There are now a lot of exciting new features for you to try out - most significantly, some new story elements which include the ability to explore interiors!

Interior encounters
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38709509/0eab9084d494785446fa411e9d980140c483bd42.gif


There is a completely new tutorial area and lots of new locations to explore as part of this update. Not all areas in the full game are accessible from the prologue of course, but the huge open world is now visible from certain locations.

Bigger world
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38709509/41a968bfed48c9424443ed5b767976a01464c262.gif


There are a number of new art assets throughout the game which we are constantly improving on. We have also made further improvements to the navigation controls, as well as the fire building and fog mechanics.

New location previews
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38709509/d316381ab9f0f2bca9056d5262d91eafe60e0eb3.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38709509/6e0cd85a8bdc70f81f5dce3cd37681b75357eeb8.gif


Please feel free to make use of our new in-game bug reporting feature - you can use the new (brief) feedback form accessible via the pause menu to let us know what you think of the update.

The future

We’re planning to release weekly updates to the prologue as we get closer to the final release. We’ve been working really hard to expand our original prototype into a much bigger game that has a full 2-3 hours of play with significantly more to do and see. We’re aiming to have Imagined Leviathans ready for sometime next month, but more on that soon!

In the meantime, wishlist Imagined Leviathans below!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1528030/Imagined_Leviathans/

Happy surviving!
